about: The road network. places are its nodes: the 220 settlements (ids 1 to 220, a settlement's id being its county's number) and the forks where roads part outside a settlement (ids from 221). stretches are its edges: road from one place to the next. roads are the 351 roads between neighbouring settlements, each a run of stretches; roads share stretches where they run together.
drawing: A stretch is drawn 3 px wide if highway, otherwise 2 px. Drawing the stretches as the picture did gives the red and the dark brown of Roads.png exactly.

fields.points: [x, y] in pixels of the map, about a pixel apart, from the stretch's from place to its to place. A settlement's end is the middle of its dot, which the picture draws over.
fields.km: the stretch's length along its line; a road's km is the length it was laid at, a little longer than its stretches' lines, which are smoothed
fields.stretches (of a road): [stretch id, true if the road runs it from its from to its to]
fields.highway: a road on the way between the capitals of two kingdoms that share a border; a stretch is highway if any road over it is
fields.bridges: at is the middle of the water crossed; from and to are the ends of the mark, which reaches 2 px on to each bank; water_px is how much water the road crosses; river is the river of Rivers.json it crosses and river_m3s that river's flow there; at_settlement is true within 12 px of a dot. A bridge is drawn 2 px wider than its road. The one bridge over the sea joins the island town (220) to the mainland.
